description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (product /dp or romantic search). ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale for the user. Does not invent Associates tags — uses server-configured tags per storefront. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.com, amazon.se, us, se, de. REQUIRED — curated catalogs with real /dp ASINs on amazon.se (Sweden, default) and amazon.com (United States: marketplace=amazon.com → https://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN links); other marketplaces get romantic search deep-links.

name: resolve_product
title: Resolve buy / inspiration link
